title: Provide processing-owned purge cleanup

verify.summary: Independent T3 verification reran the isolated multi-revision PostgreSQL/MinIO cleanup probe, typecheck and Memory Bank lint. It proved owner-local deletion of all processing faces/states and derivatives, idempotent rollback/retry convergence, and retention of Photo/original, Promo, Attempt, diagnostic and serving state.
Fresh independent T3 semantic verification found no admitted concern.
Autopilot closed TASK-109 after independent functional PASS and required T3 semantic-pass.

evidence_required: Photo Processing inventory-purge cleanup obligation RED: processing has no public owner-only operation that removes every revision's faces/state and deterministic derivatives for one inactive Photo; GREEN: one typed processing boundary identifies/deletes all owned derivatives idempotently, stages every owned row deletion and touches no Photo/original or foreign row; decisive comparison: disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO fixtures with multiple revisions inject a pre-commit failure, rerun cleanup and compare every processing object/row plus unchanged inventory, Promo, Attempt and evidence state; artifact: state/object manifest and focused redacted output under .tasks/TASK-109-T3-FT-012-W1/.
purpose: Provide the one processing-owned destructive operation needed by inventory hard purge while preserving capability write ownership.
success_outcome: For one authorized inactive Photo, processing cleanup idempotently removes all processing rows and derivatives across revisions without touching another capability's state.
anti_goals: Do not select purge targets, persist a purge run, change Photo visibility/progress or delete the Photo/original.
Do not add or change worker arbitration, a job, target, retry or operation-history table, worker service, scheduler, priority or preemption.
Do not mutate Promo sessions/results, core Attempts, diagnostics or serving settings.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL/MinIO, operator/default media and running worker processes
Inventory Photo/original/run/progress writes and all Promo/Attempt/diagnostics state
Worker arbitration, new worker, jobs/targets/history tables, scheduler, priority and preemption
stop_conditions: Complete cleanup cannot be exposed through the accepted processing owner without an ownership-crossing cascade or direct inventory write.
Idempotent derived-object and row cleanup requires a generic jobs/retry subsystem or extra worker.
The destructive proof cannot be confined to known disposable rows/object prefixes with safe rerun and complete cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner and expected code root are processing at src/face_moment/processing/; inventory is the only accepted caller/orchestrator.
Cover every PhotoPipelineState, PhotoFace and preview/thumbnail object for the supplied Photo UUID across all revisions.
Run destructive probes only against named disposable rows and a private test object prefix, with safe rerun and complete cleanup.
invariants: Processing deletes only its own rows and derived objects and never changes Photo visibility, purge progress or foreign-owned state.
No database cascade crosses the processing/inventory or processing/Promo/diagnostics boundary.
Repeated cleanup after any pre-commit object-deletion interruption converges without false success or duplicate state.
verification_targets: A disposable multi-revision Photo fixture proves complete face/state/preview/thumbnail removal, idempotent object deletion and safe rerun after injected pre-commit failure.
State comparison proves Photo/original, Promo result/session, core Attempt, diagnostic evidence and serving configuration remain unchanged.
Import/schema inspection proves the exact processing owner boundary and absence of cross-owner cascade, jobs/targets/history tables, worker changes or a new worker.
